learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Paths written by Cursor Cameroon that lead to the Cursor course, without reusing its wording.
learn.intro: Four paths written here, to prepare a meetup or a solo session. Each one leads to the Cursor course. The explanations, examples, and videos stay on their site.
learn.note: These cards do not reproduce the course. They describe how we use it in Cameroon.

model.title: See what the model is looking at
model.body: Before a suggestion, write down what is actually open: the file, its neighbors, the error on screen. If that context would not be enough for a teammate, it is not enough for the model. The official course explains how this works. This path is the pause we take first.

diff.title: One intention, one diff, one review
diff.body: State the intention in a sentence, ask for a bounded change, then read the diff the way you would read someone else's. Keep what you understand and drop the rest. The pace comes from our cafés, not from a script in the course.

recover.title: Three ways out when it drifts
recover.body: If the proposal wanders, narrow the ask, point at an example already in the repo, or stop. Repeating the same sentence is not a path. Pick one of those three, then return to the course to see why it diverged.

cafe.title: Bring one question to the next café
cafe.body: Pick a snippet, place the tool's proposal beside it, and talk it through in Yaoundé, Douala, or online. The link opens the Cursor course. The conversation stays with the community.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Venues, visibility, and other support for Cursor Cameroon meetups. No logo is shown without permission.
partners.introLead: A meetup needs a room, a signal boost, and sometimes a helping hand.
partners.introBody: Becoming a partner means opening a venue, telling your students, members, or teams about the community, or offering another kind of support. Each agreement is discussed directly with the team. An organisation's logo is published only after permission, as an SVG or a WebP under 30 KB.
partners.directoryEmptyBody: No partner is published yet. We do not show placeholder logos: a name appears here only once an agreement is in place, and a logo only when permission is given.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Who processes contact and partnership form data, for what purpose, for how long, and how to ask for deletion.
privacy.pendingBanner: Items marked “To confirm” are not validated yet. This page does not invent a controller, a retention period, or a legal contact.
privacy.intro: This page describes how data sent through the Cursor Cameroun contact and partnership forms is processed. It is written with Cameroonian Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 relating to personal data protection in mind.
privacy.disclaimer: This text informs people who write through the form. It is not legal advice.
privacy.controllerBody: The controller is the person or organisation that decides why and how messages are used. That identity is not settled for this site yet.
privacy.controllerPending: Identity of the controller: name, legal form, and address. To be confirmed before publication.
privacy.purposeBody: The name, email address, subject, and message are used to read the request and reply to it. The consent box records that the person accepts this use for this message. The information is not presented here as being used for prospecting.
privacy.dataBody: The form sends the name, email address, subject, message, and consent choice. When real delivery is enabled, the message is emailed to the recipient configured for the site, through the provider Resend. The site does not copy these messages into its database.
privacy.technicalBody: A rate limit uses the IP address for the duration of the request, in the memory of the server that receives it. That address is not stored in the site database. If Cloudflare Turnstile is enabled, an invisible check runs on submit and a technical token is verified with Cloudflare. Invisible Turnstile requires a link to Cloudflare’s privacy addendum, below. Without both Turnstile keys, this check does not run.
privacy.retentionBody: How long messages are kept, once they reach the recipient’s mailbox or the email provider, is not set on this page.
privacy.retentionPending: Retention period. No numeric duration is shown until it has been validated.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for access to the data from your message, for correction or deletion, and you can withdraw the consent given through the form. Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 frames the protection of this data. The channel for sending a request is not published yet.
privacy.rightsPending: Contact for a deletion request or to exercise your rights. To be confirmed. No legal address is listed here in the meantime.
privacy.partnersBody: The Become a partner form sends the organisation name, the contact person's name, the WhatsApp number, the contact preference, the email address, the city, the country when the city is Diaspora, an optional link, the sector, the offers, the venue details if that offer is ticked, and a free-text note. It does not ask for a logo. This data is used to review the proposal and reply to it. It is emailed to the recipient configured for the site, through Resend, and it is not copied into the site database. The controller, the retention period, and the contact for deletion remain the items marked to confirm on this page.
